provider: General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans (GEBCO)
retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of the published April 2026 global terrain grid and its Type Identifier companion. No GEBCO grid bytes were acquired or committed.
intended_use: Global terrain and bathymetry reference for tsunami, coastal-flood, storm-surge, terrain-context and cross-peril geospatial research. The grid is an interpolated information product and is not treated as navigation data, an event catalogue or direct hazard intensity.

licensing.licence_name: GEBCO Grid Terms of Use (public-domain information product with attribution conditions)
licensing.terms_version_or_date: GEBCO terms page reviewed 2026-08-10; GEBCO_2026 published April 2026
licensing.attribution_requirements: Acknowledge the GEBCO_2026 Grid using the provider's dataset attribution; do not imply GEBCO/IHO/IOC endorsement and do not misrepresent the grid or its source.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: The reviewed GEBCO terms permit copying, publication, distribution, transmission, adaptation and commercial exploitation; no share-alike requirement is stated for the GEBCO Grid information product.
licensing.notes: GEBCO explicitly places the Grid information product in the public domain while imposing source acknowledgement and non-endorsement/non-misrepresentation conditions. The underlying source bathymetric measurements are not distributed as part of the GEBCO Grid and are outside this admission.

redistribution.conditions: The source-rights ceiling permits redistribution/adaptation of the GEBCO Grid subject to the GEBCO acknowledgement and disclaimer conditions. OpenCatastrophe approves metadata only; no exact grid artifact is identified for publication.

privacy.notes: The reviewed product is a public global terrain/bathymetry information product. This assessment does not apply to underlying source survey datasets not distributed as part of the Grid.

spatial.crs: EPSG:4326 horizontal grid; elevations are metres and GEBCO documents heterogeneous source vertical datums with an assumed mean-sea-level basis
spatial.extent: Global ocean and land at 15 arc-second intervals; ice-surface and under-ice variants are provided for polar regions

temporal.extent: GEBCO_2026 publication snapshot; source measurements have heterogeneous acquisition dates and are not an event time series

variables_and_units.name: elevation
variables_and_units.description: Pixel-centre terrain elevation/depth in the GEBCO_2026 Grid. Resolution must not be interpreted as measurement density or local accuracy.

variables_and_units.name: type identifier
variables_and_units.description: Companion TID Grid code describing the type of source information used for each corresponding grid cell.

review.notes: Metadata-only engineering approval based on the authoritative GEBCO_2026 product and terms pages. No external grid bytes are admitted. Any later raw proposal must select an exact variant/file or bounded subset, record byte identities and preserve the TID/errata/vertical-datum limitations relevant to the selected asset.
